items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: So I went to Pete Ricca and said, I would like to buy the house.

ctx.x: House not confused. Yeah. All right. So when his, when his, when he was, when he was, when he was, when he was being, I'm running ahead now on the list of my list of questions, but I'm going to probably do that a lot. When his house was being torn down, were you involved with the preservationist movement, you know, to save the house?

Well, there wasn't, there wasn't a real preservationist movement. Well, I heard that the house was going to be torn down by Pete Ricca. So I went to Pete Ricca and said, I would like to buy the house. And he said, you're too late because I already got the contract to tear it down. And he said, I got to go ahead with it. Uh-huh. So I couldn't do it. We didn't even come to money at that time.
Yeah. So he, there wasn't any.
